name: Irresistible Johnson
source:
Lab accident > Super Penis > Curse, not a blessing. The goal of the game is rather simple: to provide enough semen to the Semen Analyzer to eventually produce a valuable product for your company. It's just hard to do this when everyone wants to shag you.​

[From F95]
